hook: Hyderabad airport's Runway 09R moves from *CAT II* to *CAT III*
hook_b: Hyderabad airport's Runway 09R moves from *CAT II* to *CAT III*
tldr: GMR Hyderabad International Airport commissioned CAT III airfield ground lighting on Runway 09R, letting planes operate in much lower visibility.

beats.what: Upgrades include CAT III runway lighting, advanced monitoring and stand guidance lights for pilots.
beats.why: Winter fog causes diversions and delays; the move from CAT II to CAT III is meant to cut those.
beats.care: Flying out of or into Hyderabad this winter? Fewer fog diversions are the stated goal.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: GHIAL commissioned CAT III Airfield Ground Lighting for Runway 09R, plus Stand Manoeuvring Guidance Lights and a PLC-SCADA control system at the Airport Predictive Operation Centre.

cards.q: Has fog ever delayed or diverted a flight you took?

qs: How many flights were diverted from Hyderabad by fog last winter?

facts.t: The upgrade moves Runway 09R from *CAT II* to *CAT III* capability.

learn.t: CAT III = the highest instrument landing category, allowing landings in very low visibility.

watch: Whether fog-related diversions at Hyderabad fall this winter.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Hyderabad Airport upgrades Runway 09R for CAT III operations

fact: Hyderabad airport's Runway *09R* can now handle *CAT III* low-visibility landings.
twist: Even the runway lights are now run centrally by an indigenously developed PLC-SCADA system from the airport's operations centre.
